summary: The Discord Forges are the industrial engine of the Muramite Legion. Here, corrupted machinery, molten Discord ore, and war-born energy are shaped into weapons capable of planar invasion.
history: Formed when Discord energy condensed into molten ore pools.
Muramite warlords seized the region and constructed massive forges.
Discord-forged weapons were created for the Kuua invasion.
Slagstorm engines were built to stabilize unstable rifts.
The Core Anvil became the heart of Muramite war production.
